title: Chapter 1378 - 3: You Have The Gray Ancestor, I Have The Galaxy

Chapter 1378 - 3: You Have The Gray Ancestor, I Have The Galaxy

Chapter 1378: Chapter 3: You Have the Gray Ancestor, I Have the Galaxy

Nowadays, the universe within Lin Yuan is practically equivalent to a dimensional space, where life has broken through to the Thirteenth Rank, similarly creating a time loop area.

The time loop area forms under the operation of the Supreme Rule Dao, and even Lin Yuan, the master of the universe within, cannot prevent or isolate it.

...

Deep in his mind.

Lin Yuan purposefully left a consciousness avatar to observe the third Source World closely, ultimately selecting the vessel for his descent.

"The Seventh Layer of the Infinite Void, wanting to fully develop it relies on the previous accumulations alone, which are not enough; I estimate more understanding is required of another Origin Source world’s operation."

Lin Yuan uses the Myriad Realms Gate to remotely observe the third Source World.

Currently, in the Seventh Layer of the Infinite Void, he has only developed the first third.

The remaining two-thirds become increasingly arduous, requiring more comprehension of the Origin Source world’s operation.

"It’s about enough."

"This vessel is the one."

Lin Yuan exhales lightly; this period, his consciousness avatar had been choosing a suitable vessel, and after observing millions upon millions of time lines, finally made a decision.

"This Source World..."

Lin Yuan’s expression inevitably turns solemn, having gained considerable understanding of the third Source World after observing numerous timelines.

"Let’s begin."

Lin Yuan gathers his thoughts and immediately begins to partition part of his mind’s will.

After stepping into the Thirteenth Rank, the essence of life leaps vastly, causing his mind’s will to surge.

Were it not so, even without warnings from the Myriad Realms Gate, Lin Yuan wouldn’t have chosen to traverse and descend so quickly.

After the Twelfth Rank, traversal descent generally means cultivating another completely independent true self, requiring the division of part of the mind’s will.

However, if too much of the mind’s will is divided, it will impact his true self.

Therefore, even though he can traverse and descend, Lin Yuan keeps the division of mind’s will within an acceptable range.

Swish.

Soon.

Nearly a tenth of his mind’s will is divided, flowing into the Myriad Realms Gate.

Following the coordinates of the third Source World, he crosses infinite distances, merging into the past.

The third Source World equally rejects foreign time life, combined with the presence of Time Lord level time life presiding, basically ruling out any invasion possibility by outsiders.

Yet, Lin Yuan merges silently into the world with the Myriad Realms Gate’s aid, becoming an authentic indigenous being.

Even if Time Life, including a Time Lord, observed Lin Yuan’s past timeline, nothing abnormal would appear.

...

Milky Way Dimension.

A vast Milky Way sweeps through multiple timespaces of past and future.

At a certain location on the Milky Way, over ten Time Life silhouettes are in a standoff.

Further away, numerous Time Life are spectating.

These Time Life reside in the Milky Way Dimension as other Time Lives, now facing the seven Time Lives from Chaos Void and nine Time Lives from Taixu Dimension in conflict.

The many spectating Time Lives watch with interest.

Whether it’s Chaos Void or Taixu Dimension, they are powerful factions in the vast dimensional interstice regions nearby.

Such factions producing conflicts and battles are rare entertainment for Time Lives traversing long ages.

"Fight, let them fight."

"It’s best if tempers flare, leading to mutual defeat."

Numerous spectating Time Lives talk in low tones; should Chaos Void and Taixu Dimension be mutually defeated, they certainly will greatly tighten their land force in the Milky Way Dimension.

Thus naturally allowing them to annex.

"Mutual defeat?"

"The hope isn’t very high."

More Time Lives gently shake their heads.

Time Lives are surely not fools and wouldn’t let outsiders reap the benefits.

In the many future timelines observed by Time Lives, the likelihood of Chaos Void and Taixu Dimension ending in mutual defeat? It’s extremely small.

The bigger possibility is Taixu Dimension seizing the Heart of Heavenly River and then withdrawing from the Milky Way Dimension while the seven Time Lives of Chaos Void retain their territory within the Milky Way, waiting for the next Heart of Heavenly River Dimension.

The secondary possibility is Chaos Void seizing the Heart of Heavenly River, resulting in Taixu Dimension voluntarily withdrawing.

As for mutual defeat? Neither Chaos Void nor Taixu Dimension would let themselves end up in such a situation.

No matter the result, for these Time Lives, there is no loss.

Conversely, they can take advantage of this conflict to discern the many cards held by Chaos Void and Taixu Dimension, preparing for future engagements.

...

The mighty river water sweeps.

A Time Life from Taixu Dimension is engaged with ’Zhu Yin’ of Chaos Void.

A terrifying aura bursts forth, spreading to all directions, entirely absorbed by the infinite Heavenly River Water.

"Hmm?"

The Master of Taixu, gazing nonchalantly at the battle below, suddenly moved slightly, lifting his hand to stir ripples of time and space, pressing towards ’Zhu Yin’.

"Taixu, if you want to act, have you asked me?"

Lord Mo Xu, smiling, also acted simultaneously, intercepting the Master of Taixu’s strike.

The next moment.

’Zhu Yin’ of Chaos Void suddenly expanded in form, transforming into a colossal Candle Dragon, roaring towards the Time Life from Taixu Dimension.

Time and space shattered. The Time Life of Taixu Dimension was evidently overwhelmed and retreated explosively.

"Hmph."

The Master of Taixu snorted coldly, looking distantly at Lord Mo Xu.

"Lord Mo Xu, listen to me, obediently relinquish this Heart of Heavenly River."

The Master of Taixu stood atop the surging river water, his gaze cold.

"Relinquish the Heart of Heavenly River?"

Lord Mo Xu sneered: "This Heart of Heavenly River, Chaos Void has awaited for ages, and you demand we relinquish it so easily?"

"Relinquishing is for your own good."

The Master of Taixu said.

Ideally, he preferred not to have too much trouble with Chaos Void.

If Chaos Void voluntarily withdrew, leading to no Time Life suffering injuries, the resulting animosity would naturally be less, with potential future resolution.

But if Chaos Void did not yield, using the trump card granted by ’Gray Ancestor’, high-intensity combat would inevitably ensue, leading to injuries.

Chaos Void and Taixu Dimension’s hatred would then be difficult to reconcile.

Though the benefits promised by ’Gray Ancestor’ rendered the Master of Taixu indifferent to such animosity.

Yet, avoiding conflict is naturally better.

"No need to say more."

Lord Mo Xu shook his head.

Guarding with vigilance.

With Lin Yuan’s warning—behind Taixu Dimension stands a Second Realm Time Life.

Lord Mo Xu clearly understood why the Master of Taixu dared declare such words.

The facts revealed by the Master of Taixu were accurate; Chaos Void withdrawing voluntarily was indeed the best choice.

"If that’s the case, let’s settle this with action and outcome."

The Master of Taixu stepped forward, the infinite Heavenly River Water surged overwhelmingly, sweeping towards Lord Mo Xu, encompassing multiple timespaces.

Lord Mo Xu felt the jade composed of vast runes in his body, slightly reassured:

"Behind your Taixu Dimension stands a Second Realm Time Life; Chaos Void also has the Galaxy."
